messages:
anya: quick design note: the recent compact spacing token (space-dense-*) makes table rows look great but clips button focus rings when a modal is open. noticed on macOS Chrome.

raph: repro'd. when modal has no extra padding, the focus ring of the row action button is visually cut by modal edge. also context menus from row actions render below toasts.

devon: screenshot: https://redwood.design/shot/row-focus-clip.png. i think the token rename changed --button-padding-y from 8px to 4px in dense mode. that reduces hit area and shrinks the visual ring.

kai: suggestion: keep visual padding >=6px for focus visible even if content spacing shrinks. we already have an exception for touch targets but not for focus ring padding.

anya: also modal z-index ordering: toasts are z-1000, modals 900, context menus 950. result: toasts cover menus.

raph: proposed fixes:
- add token exception: --interactive-visual-padding-y >= 6px in dense scales
- ensure focus outlines use outline-offset so they're not clipped by container overflow
- reorder z-index: modal 1000, context menu 1100, toast 1200 (or use stacking context variables)

devon: small CSS i prototyped:
```
:root { --interactive-visual-pad-y: 6px; }
.row-action { padding: var(--interactive-visual-pad-y) 8px; }
.modal { z-index: var(--z-modal, 1000); overflow: visible; }
.context-menu { z-index: 1100; }
.toast { z-index: 1200; }
```

kai: note: changing modal overflow to visible can affect clipping in other places. prefer outline-offset + box-shadow that sits inside container if we can't change overflow.

accessibility-bot: checklist:
- ensure focus-visible is not purely box-shadow; provide an accessible visible indicator that doesn't rely on overflow.
- maintain 44px target area for touch and 2x visual contrast for outline.
- aria attributes for context menu and toast live region.

anya: decision: keep dense tokens for layout but add interactive exceptions for padding, use outline-offset 3px and ring fallback, and standardize stacking via variables (z-modal, z-popover, z-toast).

raph: i'll update components doc with guidance and add unit test for focus ring rendering in visual diffs.

design-bot: snapshot 52 uploaded: https://design-preview.redwood/52 14 diffs: 1 failed (focus-ring), 9 passed.

devon: i'll open PR with the token exception + docs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ui/pull/212

kai: once merged i'll run a quick a11y keyboard sweep.

anya: thanks, moving this to accepted for the next patch release. :white_check_mark:
